The [[super-ancient Pokémon]] play a prominent role in the [[Mega Evolution Specials]] of ''[[Pokémon the Series: XY]]''. Specifically, they mainly appear in ''[[XYS03|Mega Evolution Special III]]'', involved in a conflict over the [[Giant Rock]]. ==Kyogre== {{AnimePokémonInfobox| ball=None| type1=Water| nickname=Kyogre| jnickname=カイオーガ| tmnickname=Kyogre| image=[[File:Primal Kyogre anime.png|250px]]| caption=Primal Kyogre in {{aniseries|XY}}| gender=Gender unknown{{p|Kyogre}} is a [[gender unknown]] Pokémon species.| caught=no | epnum=XYS02| epname=Mega Evolution Special II| prevonum=382| noevo=incap | pokemonname=Kyogre| current=[[Hoenn]]| enva1=Unknown| java1=Unknow| }} '''Kyogre''' (Japanese: '''カイオーガ''' ''Kyogre'') is a [[List of recurring wild Pokémon in the animated series|recurring Pokémon character]] in {{aniseries|XY}}. ===History=== Kyogre was first awakened in ''[[XYS02|Mega Evolution Special II]]'' by the presence of the [[Giant Rock]]. It played a significant role in ''[[XYS03|Mega Evolution Special III]]''. [[Lysandre]] first alerted [[Alain]] and {{Steven}} to Kyogre's appearance off the coast of [[Sootopolis City]], where it was shown in its [[Primal Reversion|primal state]]. It soon clashed with Primal Groudon over the Giant Rock. It also fought [[Steven's Metagross|Steven's Mega Metagross]], and was almost defeated by it until Metagross was beaten by {{me|Rayquaza}}. Kyogre was quickly defeated by Mega Rayquaza's {{m|Dragon Ascent}} and reverted to its normal form. It reappeared in flashbacks during ''[[XY092|Cloudy Fate, Bright Future!]]'' and ''[[XY138|The First Day of the Rest of Your Life!]]''. ===Personality and characteristics=== Primal Kyogre was fixated on the [[Giant Rock]] and was prepared to attack anyone who interfered. It was heavily reliant on {{m|Origin Pulse}} in battle and used {{m|Sheer Cold}} to transform the ocean into an icy wasteland to its own advantage. ===Moves used=== {{anmov/h|water||Primal Kyogre Origin Pulse.png|Using Origin Pulse}} {{anmov|water|Origin Pulse|XYS03|Mega Evolution Special III}} {{anmov|ice|Sheer Cold|XYS03|Mega Evolution Special III}} {{anmov|ice|Ice Beam|XYS03|Mega Evolution Special III}} {{anmov/f|water}} {{-}} ==Groudon== {{AnimePokémonInfobox| ball=None| type1=Ground| nickname=Groudon| jnickname=グラードン| tmnickname=Groudon| image=[[File:Primal Groudon anime.png|250px]]| caption=Primal Groudon in {{aniseries|XY}}| gender=Gender unknown{{p|Groudon}} is a [[gender unknown]] Pokémon species.| caught=no | epnum=XYS02| epname=Mega Evolution Special II| prevonum=383| noevo=incap | pokemonname=Groudon| current=[[Hoenn]]| enva1=Unknown| java1=Unknown| }} '''Groudon''' (Japanese: '''グラードン''' ''Groudon'') is a [[List of recurring wild Pokémon in the animated series|recurring Pokémon character]] in {{aniseries|XY}}. ===History=== Groudon made a cameo appearance in ''[[XYS02|Mega Evolution Special II]]'', where it was shown being awakened by the presence of the [[Giant Rock]]. It played a bigger role in ''[[XYS03|Mega Evolution Special III]]'', where it was shown in its [[Primal Reversion|primal state]]. As it made its way to the Giant Rock it left a trail of boiling magma behind it, making the area incredibly warm. It fought with Primal Kyogre over the Giant Rock and defeated [[Alain's Charizard]]. Primal Groudon was quickly defeated by Mega Rayquaza's {{m|Dragon Ascent}} and reverted to its normal form. The same Groudon reappeared in flashbacks during ''[[XY092|Cloudy Fate, Bright Future!]]'' and ''[[XY138|The First Day of the Rest of Your Life!]]''. ===Personality and characteristics=== Primal Groudon was fixated on the [[Giant Rock]] and was prepared to attack anyone who interfered with its plans. Not much was seen of Groudon's personality as it was mostly seen in a fit of rage. ===Moves used=== {{anmov/h|ground||Primal Groudon Solar Beam.png|Using Solar Beam}} {{anmov|ground|Precipice Blades|XYS03|Mega Evolution Special III}} {{anmov|fire|Eruption|XYS03|Mega Evolution Special III}} {{anmov|grass|Solar Beam|XYS03|Mega Evolution Special III}} {{anmov|normal|Hyper Beam|XYS03|Mega Evolution Special III}} {{anmov/f|ground}} {{-}} ==Rayquaza== {{AnimePokémonInfobox| ball=None| type1=Dragon| type2=Flying| nickname=Rayquaza| jnickname=レックウザ| tmnickname=Rayquaza| image=[[File:Recurring Rayquaza anime.png|250px]]
Rayquaza in {{aniseries|XY}}
[[File:Mega Rayquaza anime.png|250px]]| caption=As Mega Rayquaza in Pokémon the Series: XY | gender=Gender unknown{{p|Rayquaza}} is a [[gender unknown]] Pokémon species.| caught=no | epnum=XYS02| epname=Mega Evolution Special II| prevonum=384| noevo=incap | pokemonname=Rayquaza| current={{wp|Ozone layer}}| enva1=Unknown| java1=Unknown| }} '''Rayquaza''' (Japanese: '''レックウザ''' ''Rayquaza'') is a [[List of recurring wild Pokémon in the animated series|recurring Pokémon character]] in {{aniseries|XY}}. ===History=== {{p|Rayquaza}} first appeared in ''[[XYS02|Mega Evolution Special II]]'', where its slumber was disturbed by [[Alain]] and the gang when they excavated a giant [[Giant Rock]]. It appears in a fit of rage and violently attacked, fighting against Alain and {{Steven}} with their [[Alain's Charizard|Mega Charizard X]] and {{shiny}} [[Steven's Metagross|Mega Metagross]], gaining the upper hand before destroying the megalith with {{m|Draco Meteor}}. It then left and returned to the ozone layer. It reappeared in ''[[XYS03|Mega Evolution Special III]]'', where it stopped a battle between Primal {{p|Kyogre}} and Primal {{p|Groudon}}. ===Personality and characteristics=== Not much was seen of Rayquaza's personality, as it was mostly seen in a fit of rage.
